method: Third-party historical public-count tables accessed through Arena page retrieval. The rendered pages also contained rows or updates dated 2026-11-12, conflicting with the trusted date. Historical rows are retrospective third-party records, not independently verified YouTube Studio data or verified current counts; they may be revised. Public subscribers are rounded.

sources.interpretation: A large established channel's displayed public counters rose between provider-dated rows; no attribution to a particular video, verified net subscriber gain, exact daily velocity, current trend, income or small-channel expectation is justified.

Retrospective provider-reported October change. The subscriber change reflects rounded display steps, not a verified exact increase; the page was rendered as updated 2026-11-12, after the trusted date.
